idea: fun project-prompt creator with subject packs (real estate, law, finance, science) + Brain Scout idea expander
spec_digest: Playful React+Vite SPA that generates fun, well-scoped project prompts across Real Estate / Law / Finance / Science subject packs
Core: seedable deterministic randomizer, difficulty+time tags with filters, copy + localStorage favorites
Brain Scout: seed idea -> 4-rung scope ladder (Weekend->Moonshot) + 3 subject-lens remixes, all client-side, mobile-first
No backend, no external APIs, no template editor; toy-like feel, tool-like speed
Done = must-haves verified in a live browser + vitest green + build passes + responsive 375/1280

decisions.what: Design: 'Spark Machine' — winning AMBITIOUS brief (judge 36/40). TS React+Vite, 3 layers: frozen contract (types.ts, schema.ts, tokens.css) -> pure core (rng/generate/brainScout/share/markdown, data packs) -> thin UI. Delighters only after must-haves green.
decisions.why: Judge: every must-have + domain rule traces to a named file and test, incl. the twist pool MINIMAL missed; buildable in parallel waves

decisions.what: Grafted steals: scout-favorites id hash('scout:'+seed+label); packs test asserts every subject x difficulty combo non-empty; seed-as-serial on prompt card; prefers-reduced-motion guard; mixed-case verbatim-seed test
decisions.why: Best loser ideas at near-zero cost
